olivia_sales: Prospect (DroneHealth) requested SOC2 Type II (redacted ok), ISO27001 cert, and a one-page pen-test attestation for their procurement checklist. Need by next Monday. Also asked whether sharing these docs changes the quoted POC fees. tagging @ben_se @liya_compliance @matt_legal

ben_se: POC scheduled on hosted sandbox. Sharing redacted artifacts for evaluation should not change POC fees. Dedicated or on-prem would be quoted separately. I'll include a sanitized dataflow diagram for the POC.

liya_compliance: We can assemble a redacted SOC2 attestation page, the ISO27001 certificate, and a signed pen-test attestation (scope + date). We do NOT share raw findings or vulnerability scan exports without a signed NDA + internal approval. ETA to collate and sign: 48-72 hours.

matt_legal: Confirmed. I'll prepare our standard one-way NDA and a permitted-use clause restricting redistribution. If they request full pen-test details we need a completed request form and exec sign-off.

olivia_sales: They want a one-line procurement entry: "no change to POC fees for evidence sharing" — please provide final wording I can paste.

ben_se: Copy-paste: "Sharing redacted compliance artifacts for vendor evaluation will not change the quoted POC fees; any requested changes to hosting or support entitlements may be quoted separately."

liya_compliance: Plan for files to upload: SOC2-Redacted-2024.pdf, ISO27001-Certificate.pdf, PenTest-Attestation-Liya-signed.pdf, POC-Dataflow-Sanitized.pdf, Evidence-Cover-Letter.pdf. Will upload to secure bucket and share link to sales/legal once NDA status known.

evidence_bot: Upload queued: gs://redwood-evidence/poc-requests/1779999999/ (access pending).

liya_compliance: Uploaded and set ACL to sales+se+legal. Link DM'd to @olivia_sales. Marking ready pending NDA for pen-test attestation.
